title: A High-Quality Text-Rich Image Instruction Tuning Dataset via Hybrid Instruction Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a dataset for text-rich image instruction following and multimodal alignment. Although some image samples in the appendix include content related to philosophy (Stoicism) or religion (Jewish history), these are provided only as examples of text-rich visual data and are not used for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
